diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.file_permission must wait for :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key before chmod runs; the supplied graph contains no ordering edge (although the source shows a depends_on). Reference the created file's filename in the command.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance can start the runner before module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.instance_docker_machine_policy grants its role permission to provision docker-machine instances. Wait for the attachment before launching the runner.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm so startup token-management operations have their required SSM permissions when enabled.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token. Otherwise user data can write the registration token before Terraform creates the placeholder parameter, causing a creation conflict or replacement of the token.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.instance so the logging agent has its CloudWatch permissions at startup when logging is enabled.
